desc:
Knead salt bread by hand and grow a tiny alley bakery into a famous brick-warehouse landmark! 🥐

🥖 Hand-knead 16 breads — rub, fold, pipe cream, braid brioche, pour canelés and lay gold leaf with your fingers.
⭐ Level up your Baker Grade from Apprentice to Master to unlock new hand-made breads.
🏪 Hire clerks and bakers, add ovens and mixers, and expand your shop up to three floors.
🛋️ Decorate freely with furniture, props, ceiling lights, plants, wallpaper and floors.
🎃 Halloween week: pumpkin salt bread and limited décor until Nov 1.
🍞 Visit other bakeries, taste their bread and fill your Bread Book.

Best with headphones on — the dough sounds are crunchy! 🎧
